steps.caption: Reply templates and auto-reply rules, split out of the inbox because the two are intertwined.
Rating scope decides which reviews a template is offered for. The tokens insert at the cursor.
Ratings offer stars only, because auto-reply is Google-only and Google does not do recommendations.
Per-rule history, including a failed send, so auto-reply failures have somewhere to live.
A template a rule depends on cannot be deleted. The dialog names the rule and says what to do first.
